title: pvMergeTime
body:
## pvMergeTime

Combines several time-dependent inputs into one multiblock dataset (one block per input) whose time steps are the union of the inputs' times, or their intersection with Intersection on, with near-duplicates removed using Tolerance. For each requested time, every input supplies the matching step within tolerance, otherwise its last step before that time. Use it to view or export sources with different output times together.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Inputs are not interpolated in time; a block may show an earlier step than the requested time.
- Tolerance is absolute (in time units) unless RelativeTolerance is true.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `MergeTime`. Identity: `filters/MergeTime`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input list for the native Input port. List each upstream node to connect; each entry is a node name or a {node, port} object. ParaView: This property indicates the the inputs to the Group Datasets filter. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Intersection` | Keep the intersection instead of the union of timesteps from each input. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `RelativeTolerance` | Use Relative (resp. absolute) tolerance to determine if timesteps are duplicate. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Tolerance` | Tolerance used to determine if timesteps are duplicate. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvMergeTime",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": [
      "UPSTREAM_Input"
    ]
  }
}
```
